question: The Ennum Ezhuthum scheme was launched by the Tamil Nadu government to ensure foundational Literacy and Numeracy by 2025. This scheme was launched to bridge the learning gap among students aged ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**under 8. **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Beginning with the academic year 2022–2023, the **Ennum Ezhuthum Mission** will be implemented in all government schools in Tamil Nadu.
 
• On April 4, 2022,** M K Stalin**, the chief minister of Tamil Nadu, released the **"Kaaval Uthavi" **app.
 
• Once Tamil, English, and Mathematics committees were established, meetings were held at the district and state levels, and teachers' opinions were solicited, the Ennum Ezhuthum Mission was born.
 
• The chief minister stated that the government's policy was **"education for all,"** and that primary education in particular required attention because it served as the groundwork for children's subsequent academic development.
